resolutions.researcher_notes: CONCERN: no source states a $500,000,000 cost for the Nueva Era Pipeline, and the one specific project-financing figure I did find is materially lower. IJGlobal's transaction record (Transaction ID 35133, 'Nueva Era Gas Pipeline', last updated 15/12/2016; Wayback capture http://web.archive.org/web/20210801100037/https://ijglobal.com/data/transaction/35133/nueva-era-gas-pipeline, since the live page is paywalled) states in its free summary: 'The $353.4 million proceeds will be used for the development of the Nueva Era natural gas pipeline, a 321 km of minimum 30-inch (76 cm) pipeline that extends from Howard's Webb County Hub in South Texas, United States, to Escobedo in Nuevo Leon and to the Mexican...' -- i.e. a dated, transaction-specific financing figure of $353.4 million for this pipeline's development, not $500 million. I'm not proposing this as a REFS_ADDED source for the sheet's $500M value (it contradicts it), and I'm not treating it as fully dispositive either, since IJGlobal describes it as loan/note 'proceeds' for a specific financing round rather than an unambiguous statement of total all-in project cost (there could be additional equity or other capital outside this note). I checked whether other sources corroborate either figure: Howard Midstream Partners LP's SEC Form S-1/A (2017, https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1690884/000119312517349673/d287008ds1a.htm) shows a balance-sheet line 'Construction in progress $125,440' (thousand, i.e. $125.44 million) as of December 31, 2016 -- a snapshot mid-construction, consistent in magnitude with a low-$100s-million-to-mid-$300s-million total rather than $500 million, but it does not itself state a total project cost figure, so I'm not citing it as a second source for the same $353.4M claim. Two related IJGlobal transaction records for the same pipeline -- ID 40356 ('Nueva Era Gas Pipeline Additional Facility,' holdco financing for the same ~320km line) and ID 43402 ('Nueva Era Gas Pipeline (318.6KM) Refinancing 2018') -- exist but their dollar amounts are paywalled (only generic teaser text visible via Wayback, no figure). I did not find a $500 million figure anywhere, including in: Natural Gas Intel's HEP WahaRey/AguaRey pipelines article (fetched in full, 256,941 bytes -- describes capacity/diameter/CFE offtake, no cost figure); Howard Energy Partners' own August 2015 open-season press release (recovered via Wayback PDF, https://web.archive.org/web/20240810215532/https://www.howardenergypartners.com/wp-content/uploads/2020/09/NuevaEraCFEFinal-8.12.15.pdf, extracted with pdftotext -- no cost figure); Howard Energy Partners' company growth/timeline page (recovered via Wayback, https://web.archive.org/web/20231202154519/https://www.howardenergypartners.com/growth -- the only dollar figures on the entire page are unrelated 2022 corporate financing items, '$400 million of unsecured debt' and a '$1 billion revolving credit facility', which are general HEP corporate facilities, not a Nueva Era construction cost); two El Financiero Spanish-language articles (both fetched in full -- report capacity figures, no 'inversion'/cost figure found after multiple targeted searches); Grupo Clisa's own project page (has a generic 'INVERSIONES' section heading but no dollar figure); Proyectos del Golfo (capacity only); the TxDOT International Trade Corridor Plan (2023 PDF, https://ftp.dot.state.tx.us/pub/txdot/move-texas-freight/studies/international-corridor-plan.pdf, fetched and extracted with pdftotext -- describes Nueva Era's capacity/diameter/length and CFE anchor contract in detail, no cost figure). RBN Energy's seed URL (rbnenergy.com/node/11486) turns out to be a topic/tag index page titled 'Nueva Era | RBN Energy' (confirmed via both the live 403-blocked fetch and a Wayback capture), not an article -- a navigation surface, so not usable as a citation even where accessible. San Antonio Business Journal and S&P Global Platts seed URLs both returned blocked/paywalled responses (5,933 and 597 bytes respectively) with no Wayback snapshot available for either specific article path. WebSearch quota was exhausted for this session throughout, so I could not run open web searches for a possible EIA/trade-press restatement of $500 million; all of the above came from direct fetches, Wayback recovery, and PDF extraction. Net: the one dated, project-specific dollar figure that exists ($353.4 million, IJGlobal, Dec 2016) is well below the sheet's $500 million, so this is flagged as a likely sheet overstatement/data issue for Update rather than resolved as REFS_ADDED -- I have not changed the value or proposed a citation that would misrepresent it as supporting $500,000,000.
